EmailTemplate.name: Order Return Denial
EmailTemplate.subject: Update Regarding Your Return Request
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Case #: {{{Case.CaseNumber}}}
Subject: {{{Case.Subject}}}
Issue Description: {{{Case.Issue_Description__c}}}
-----------------------------------------------------
Dear {{{Case.First_Name__c}}},
Thank you for contacting Hsu’s Ginseng Enterprises, Inc.
We have carefully reviewed your return request for item(s) on Order # {{{Case.Order_Number__c}}}. Unfortunately, we are unable to approve the return at this time because the item(s) do not meet the conditions outlined in our [Return Policy](link to return policy page).
Please note:
• Opened productsare not eligible for return or refund.
• Specialty itemsare non-returnable, regardless of whether they are opened or unopened.
If you believe this decision was made in error or have additional information to provide, please don’t hesitate to reply to this email or contact us at 1-800-826-1577. We will be happy to review your case again.
We truly appreciate your understanding and thank you for your continued support.
Warm Regards,
Customer Support Team
Hsu's Ginseng Enterprises, Inc.
